name: Image Integrity & Corrupt Preview Removal
changes: Detects near-black noisy and partial gray/neutral decoder-fill previews on all four edges.
Ensures already loaded image checks and pending hide operations survive Continuous-browsing generation changes when article identity stays the same.
Verifies the exact article identity before removing a broken image card.
Keeps image-quality checks paced and uses 64x64 sampling with row/column fast-path statistics.
regression_guards: v3.7.10 broken-image suppression and original image-quality tests are retained.
v3.7.9 bounded preview recovery and thumbnail admission remain unchanged.
v3.7.8 Image Sets ON/OFF and grouping remain unchanged.
v3.7.7 Newsgroups splitter and stable runtime remain unchanged.
preserved: NNTP, thumbnail transport/native decoder, Direct Unpack, PAR2 repair, Automation, Smart Import, Backup & Restore.
SABnzbd 5.1.2, SABCTools 9.6.3, Metadata Server v0.3.3 and Diagnostic Collector v1.0.31 remain unchanged.
